    The BGRS Figure 13 diagram D #

    Figure 13D is the mixed orientation of affine D̃₄: two one-dimensional leaves enter a two-dimensional center and two one-dimensional leaves leave it. The explicit family uses the columns e₀,e₁ and the rows (1,1) and (c,1). Naturality forces every endomorphism to be scalar, while an isomorphism between parameters forces the parameters to agree.

    The ambient theorem leaves only the literal Hom-bifunctor retraction—the source's assertion that the displayed diagram is cleaving—as a callback.
